name: lci_raw_diag
description: Raw diagnostics wire vectors (spec 11-lci.md section 17.5.4). Four kinds: (1) tx_command - POST /diag/raw/tx request bodies encoded by the real LciClient.send_raw_tx; (2) arm_command - PUT /diag/raw/rx arming request bodies encoded by the real LciClient.arm_raw_rx, plus its client-side ttl_s<=0 rejection which emits no wire bytes; (3) rx_status - GET /diag/raw/rx response payloads consumed by normalize_raw_rx_status; (4) rx_event - /diag/raw/rx/events notification payloads consumed by normalize_raw_rx_event. NOTE: no Python producer exists for rx_status/rx_event payloads (they are firmware-side); their bytes are pinned via the reference CBOR codec oracle (cbor2.dumps of the spec-shaped input) and driven through the real client decoders. Negative vectors exist only where real rejection paths exist.

vectors.name: raw_tx_frame_wait_true
vectors.description: Spec example: transmit 4-byte frame c1020304 synchronously (wait=true).

vectors.name: raw_tx_frame_wait_false_max_len
vectors.description: 255-byte frame (spec /diag max_frame_len) sent asynchronously (wait=false). Exercises two-byte CBOR byte-string length header 58 ff.

vectors.name: rx_arm_spec_example
vectors.description: Spec example: arm raw RX for 60 s with payload capture enabled.

vectors.name: rx_arm_disarm
vectors.description: Disarm raw RX early: enabled=false with a finite TTL.

vectors.name: rx_arm_reject_ttl_zero
vectors.description: Negative: ttl_s=0 is rejected client-side before any wire request is emitted (LciClient.arm_raw_rx returns state error, detail 'ttl_s must be positive', zero transport requests).

vectors.name: rx_status_disabled_spec_example
vectors.description: Spec example GET /diag/raw/rx response: raw RX disabled, no remaining time, max TTL 300 s.

vectors.name: rx_status_enabled
vectors.description: Armed window mid-flight: enabled with 42 s remaining.

vectors.name: rx_status_not_a_map
vectors.description: Negative: non-map status payload (CBOR text string) drives normalize_raw_rx_status into state error with detail '/diag/raw/rx payload is not a map'. Bytes emitted by the reference CBOR codec.

vectors.name: rx_event_full_spec_example
vectors.description: Spec example /diag/raw/rx/events notification: captured frame with RSSI/SNR/frequency/CRC metadata and capture timestamp.

vectors.name: rx_event_minimal
vectors.description: Minimal event without include_payload extras: only frame/RSSI/SNR present; optional fields normalize to None.

vectors.name: rx_event_not_a_map
vectors.description: Negative: non-map event payload (CBOR array) drives normalize_raw_rx_event into state error with detail '/diag/raw/rx/events payload is not a map'. Bytes emitted by the reference CBOR codec.
